versions.changelog:
- Initial release of daily-note-helper.
- Converts messy daily notes into clear daily summaries with key sections: overview, completed items, todos, risks, and suggestions.
- Groups similar fragments and rewrites vague notes into actionable bullets when possible.
- Marks unclear details with “待确认” instead of guessing.
- Keeps content concise and neutral, with a default output in Chinese (unless otherwise requested).
